name: background
title: Static background equations (TOV + Klein-Gordon form)
description: Static limit of the field equations: Phi(t,r) -> Phi0(r), lambda -> lambda0, a -> a0, n -> n0, xi -> 0.

Gtt.label: G_tt - 8 pi G T_tt
Gtt.text: (-4*pi*G*r**2*(2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)) + Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*n0(r) + epsilon0(n0(r)) - n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 2*V(a0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + Derivative(a0(r), r)**2) + 2*r*Derivative(lambda0(r), r) + exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*exp(2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r))/r**2

Grr.label: G_rr - 8 pi G T_rr
Grr.text: (4*pi*G*r**2*(2*(epsilon0(n0(r)) - n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 2*V(a0(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - Derivative(a0(r), r)**2) + 2*r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)/r**2

KG.label: Klein-Gordon: box a + V' + n m*'
KG.text: (r*(n0(r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) + Derivative(V(a0(r)), a0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + r*(-Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(a0(r), r) + Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r) - Derivative(a0(r), (r, 2))) - 2*Derivative(a0(r), r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/r

FLUID_r.label: radial momentum: div T(total) = 0, with KG eliminated
FLUID_r.text: (m_N*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - mstar(a0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)) - Derivative(a0(r), r)*Derivative(mstar(a0(r)), a0(r)) - Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r))*n0(r)
